name: Early Years
summary: Play, stories, songs and phonics, all in English, on the British EYFS framework.
points: Phonics, maths and literacy in Kindergarten

name: Primary
summary: Cambridge English, Maths and Science in the morning. Cooking, craft, sport and a class called Boredom after lunch.

name: Lower Secondary
summary: Cambridge Lower Secondary with subject teachers, plus History, Art of Science and the Maker Space.

name: Upper Secondary
summary: A US diploma or Cambridge pathway at their own pace, with a teacher coaching. IELTS, PTE and GED prep.
points: Personal project and a student-planned trip

name: Global Program
summary: For travelling families: a real class, half or full day, with a report and certificate at the end.
points: Progress report in the first two weeks
